rule.name: RealClockInTest
rule.message: This test reads the real clock, so its result depends on when it runs. Pass a fixed time in: a Clock.fixed(...) the subject takes, now(clock) with that clock, or a fixed Instant. Measuring elapsed time or a polling deadline is allowed: System.nanoTime(), a start time subtracted later, or now() compared in a loop.
